faq.body: If your question is not here, send it with your workflow and target market. We will answer it against the actual configuration.

items.q: How do I choose between a PDA and a tablet?
items.a: Start with the task. A PDA is better for one-handed scanning in aisles, on a ladder or in the field. A tablet is better when the operator needs a larger screen, Windows software, equipment ports or a vehicle mount. The workflow review on our Solutions page describes the usual patterns.

items.q: Are the specifications on this site final?
items.a: Only confirmed values are shown. Configuration-dependent items are confirmed against the approved datasheet for your SKU, because modules, memory, OS versions and regional approvals vary between models and markets.

items.q: Can you configure modules for a specific project?
items.a: Yes, subject to the selected platform. Barcode engines, RFID modules, NFC, document readers, memory and accessories are reviewed against the application, target market and production plan. Some options require tooling or minimum quantities.

items.q: How do I compare two models for my workflow?
items.a: Send us the workflow, environment, target market and expected volume. We will narrow the range and confirm the configuration, accessories and documentation path for each option.
